Quick answers

Common questions

Have a specific question? Open the MineAtlas helper in the bottom-right corner.

What is the difference between SHA-256 and Scrypt miners?

SHA-256 ASICs (like Antminer S21 Pro, S21 XP, or WhatsMiner M60S) mine Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash, measured in TH/s. Scrypt ASICs (like Antminer L9) mine Litecoin and Dogecoin, measured in GH/s.

Why choose an air-gapped wallet over USB/Bluetooth?

Air-gapped wallets (like Coldcard Q or Blockstream Jade Plus) sign transactions via QR codes or microSD cards without ever connecting electronically to an internet-connected computer.

Does the calculator predict mining profit?

No. It models electricity and cooling overhead in kWh and currency. Profitability depends on coin price, network difficulty, pool fees, and hardware uptime.

How do NFC smart-card wallets like Tangem work?

They house an EAL6+ secure element inside a slim card without a battery or screen, signing transactions when tapped against an NFC smartphone.
